name: Jamdani Scarf
about: A fine muslin-like scarf woven in Bangladesh. Jamdani weaving is a traditional craft of the Dhaka region.
tip: Prices vary a lot between machine-woven and hand-woven pieces, so check how it was made before you pay.

name: Nakshi Kantha Embroidery
about: A traditional Bangladeshi embroidery made with running stitches on layered cloth. It is a classic folk craft of the country.
tip: Choose a small pouch or mat if you want an easy item to carry home.

name: Jute Bag
about: A sturdy bag made from jute, a fiber Bangladesh is known for. It is a practical everyday souvenir.
